description: This file defines inductor-specific tensor operations such as matrix multiplication addition, tensor allocation from memory pool, tensor reinterpretation, and gradient accumulation. It also registers these functions with the Torch library under the 'inductor' namespace.

methods.name: Tensor _mm_plus_mm_out(Tensor & out,const Tensor & a,const Tensor & b,const Tensor & c,const Tensor & d)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication of tensors a and b, adds the result scaled by c and d to the output tensor 'out'.

methods.name: Tensor _mm_plus_mm(const Tensor & a,const Tensor & b,const Tensor & c,const Tensor & d,Tensor & out)
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls _mm_plus_mm_out, performs matrix multiplication and addition.

methods.name: Tensor _alloc_from_pool(const Tensor & self,int64_t offset_bytes,ScalarType dtype,IntArrayRef size,IntArrayRef stride)
methods.description: Allocates a tensor from a memory pool with specified offset, dtype, size, and stride.

methods.name: Tensor _reinterpret_tensor(const Tensor & self,IntArrayRef size,IntArrayRef stride,int64_t offset_increment)
methods.description: Creates a tensor view with reinterpreted size, stride, and an offset increment, similar to as_strided but with incremental offset.

methods.name: void accumulate_grad_(const Tensor & variable,const Tensor & new_grad)
methods.description: Accumulates gradient for a variable, handling device differences and updates the gradient in-place.
